title: Enhanced electrochemical sensing of lead in environmental samples using Bi2O3/IL/rGO hybrid nanocomposite
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18444-18455
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01951F, Paper
Open Access

Sanoober Bhagat, Sana-ul-Nisa, Tania Ghumro, Jamil A. Buledi, Amber R. Solangi, S. Tufail H. Sherazi
The ionic liquid BMIM-PF6 was used as stabilizing agent to synthesize Bi2O3/IL/rGO hybrid nanocomposite. A sensor was developed by modifying the surface of GCE by using hybrid nanocomposite for the detection of Pb2+ in environmental samples.
